contact.address: Apex Building, 93/A, 4th B Cross Rd, 5th Block, Koramangala / St. Marks Rd / Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560095

colour_palette.details: Wix-based theme using uncurated yellow (#fcfc3c) and dull olive (#9c9c3c) with cyan inline styling. Lacks appetizing warmth and luxury contrast.

logo.details: Logo is served as a low-resolution Wix raster image ('Yellow Updated.png') without vector SVG rendering, appearing blurry on Retina screens.

typography.details: Relies on generic Wix web font bundles with awkward kerning and oversized text containers that clip on modern mobile viewports.

contact.details: Prominent multi-outlet phone numbers, verified corporate email, and active Instagram and Facebook accounts.

online_presence.details: Heavy client-side Wix runtime with excessive JavaScript bundle size, slow First Contentful Paint, and no interactive digital menu scrollytelling.

verdict.commercial_rationale: The undisputed king of Bangalore burgers with lines around the block across Koramangala, St. Marks, and Indiranagar. Their website is a slow, generic Wix shell that does not reflect their iconic status (All American Cheese Burger, Sloppy Joe, Ferrero Rocher Shake).

sample_website.notes: Iconic Bangalore college-town diner redesign featuring the All American Cheese Burger and Ferrero Rocher Shake.
